ingredientSections.heading: Alioli
items: Salt and White Pepper to taste

methodSections.heading: Patatas
steps: Cut the potatoes into small bite size portions. Place in a pot, cover with cold water, add salt and then bring to a boil.
Strain and place the partially cooked potato on a baking tray. Season with rosemary, thyme, olive oil, finely chopped garlic, salt, pepper, and espelette.
Roast in the oven at 200°C (400°F) for approximately 30 minutes. The potatoes should be soft inside and crispy outside.
When cool enough to touch, wrap each potato in Jamon and place back in the oven at 220°C (430°F) for approximately 6 minutes or until the Jamon is crispy.
Poke a bamboo skewer into each and serve with the alioli.

methodSections.heading: Alioli
steps: Mix yolks, mustard, vinegar, salt, pepper, garlic together.
Slowly add both oils while whisking vigorously until creamy and smooth.
